<thought>The main peak at m/z 114.06808 corresponds to a protonated ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of 113.06080 Da. The formula C₆H₉O₂ has a monoisotopic mass of 113.06020 Da, matching the neutral mass within a few ppm, confirming the molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
